jobs.title: Senior Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: The "Senior" title and legal-adviser function require both seniority and a legal qualification the candidate lacks. Despite the perfect accountability/justice subject match, this fails on level and qualification.

jobs.title: Advisory Board Member
jobs.reason: An advisory board role is a senior, expert-level appointment, not an entry-level paid position for an early-career candidate. The level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Internship - Speculative Opportunities
jobs.reason: This is an internship and speculative posting with no concrete vacancy, both excluded by policy. The field fits, but the type is disqualifying.

jobs.title: Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: A legal-adviser role at an international law foundation requires a legal qualification and admission to practise, which the candidate does not hold. The accountability/justice mission is a perfect interest match but the qualification is an unmet essential.

jobs.title: OSINT Trainer and Safety Protocol Developer
jobs.reason: A "Trainer" and "Safety Protocol Developer" role requires established OSINT-training expertise and safety-protocol experience the candidate does not have; this is a specialist, not an entry-level, position. Although OSINT and atrocity documentation are core interests, the role demands prior domain seniority the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Speculative Application
jobs.reason: This is a talent-pool / speculative posting with no concrete vacancy, which is excluded by policy. No specific role to assess.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to sit on an Advisory Committee, not a paid entry-level role — it is an advisory/volunteer-type appointment seeking senior subject-matter specialists, which fails both the paid-role and entry-level tests. The human-rights subject is on-mission, but the candidate does not meet the expert-advisor level required.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.reason: "Principal" is a senior title requiring proven experience leading large-scale enterprise technology platforms and deep SAP / architecture / security expertise — far beyond the candidate's level and skills. The role is also entirely outside the candidate's research and policy interest zones.
jobs.location: London (also Birmingham, Cardiff, Glasgow, Newcastle, Salford; hybrid)

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: A Director role providing executive and public leadership over a senior team of three Deputy Directors — clearly a senior, top-level position requiring years of leadership experience the candidate does not have. The disqualifier is the level, not the field; the £80k–£95k salary and permanent executive remit confirm the mismatch.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to sit on an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks recognised specialists / activist experts (and the Spanish version implies fluency helps), which the candidate is not. It is effectively a voluntary advisory / talent-pool posting rather than a genuine paid position, so it is ineligible despite the human-rights subject matter.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper (Spain)
jobs.reason: This is a flexible freelance side-gig explicitly framed for students and occasional income, not a genuine professional role, and it requires being based in Spain. It has no connection to the candidate's research, policy or intelligence interests and involves no relevant skills.
jobs.location: Madrid / across Spain (esp. Zaragoza, Lleida, Ibiza, Mallorca)

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it is a volunteer/advisory position seeking established specialists on environmental human-rights defenders, which the candidate is not. The human-rights subject is on-mission, but it is neither a genuine paid vacancy for the candidate nor at their level.
